$comment: `reference` resolves against the golden directory, `candidate` against the candidate one.
Always relative - never absolute - so this file stays portable across machines
`id` must be stable: it becomes the JUnit <testsuite name>, the asset folder name,
and the report anchor. Jenkins keys test history off the suite name, so changing an
id silently discards that pair's trend history.
There are no tolerances. A page fails if it differs at all; `skipPages` is the only
way to exempt one, and it exempts the whole page.
